mappings.rationale: Both crosswalk directions independently confirm a single, clean 1:1 row at the same 5-digit code with no adjacent split/merge candidates. Lampiran 5 (2020->2025 direction, p.145/printed p.131) row: '08920 Ekstraksi Tanah Gemuk (Peat) -> 08920 Ekstraksi Tanah Gambut (Peat)'. Lampiran 10 (2025->2020 direction, p.337/printed p.323) row confirms the reverse: '08920 Ekstraksi Tanah Gambut (Peat) -> 08920 Ekstraksi Tanah Gemuk (Peat)'. Semantically, the 2025 uraian describes ekstraksi dan penggalian tanah gambut (peat), aglomerasi tanah gambut, penyiapan tanah gambut untuk meningkatkan kualitas atau memudahkan pengangkutan/penyimpanan, with operations meliputi penggalian, penghancuran, pencucian, penyaringan, penampungan -- functionally identical scope to the 2020 activity at the same code. The title change 'Gemuk' -> 'Gambut' is a terminology/spelling correction (gambut is the standard Indonesian term for peat; gemuk, meaning fat/grease, was an error in the 2020 published title), not a scope split or reclassification. No other 2020 code maps into 2025 08920 and no other 2025 code receives a fragment of 2020 08920 in either rendered table, ruling out SPLIT/MERGE/COLLISION.
